name: Typlog Publisher
description: Create and update Typlog drafts from Markdown, with local image uploads, captions, tags, and author selection.
author: haohailong

versions.notes: Use native Keychain storage, migrate previous Tokens, and combine publishing confirmation with metadata editing. Includes approved-read caching and image upload recovery.
Legacy build for MarkEdit 1.36.x only, with runtime guards and the updated publishing flow. Retains optional password encryption; newer hosts must use 0.4.0.
Initial registry release with direct image uploads, reusable draft associations, confirmed recovery for missing drafts, and optional local Token encryption.
